intended_object: A topological group isomorphism Y ≅ ∏_p ℤ_p / p^{e_p}ℤ_p (written multiplicatively). It is attached to a continuous surjection f from ∏_p ℤ_p onto a Hausdorff group Y, where e_p are the primewise exponents of the kernel ideal of f. It is an intermediate step toward `procyclicContinuousMulEquivModel` (from the docstring and the module doc).
